scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: The agent recovered well from the initial path issue and used the tools effectively to diagnose the build failure. The configuration mismatch analysis was insightful and well-presented. However, the response fell short on actually listing the projects (just giving a count), and was somewhat hedging on whether LrgWindowsAppManifest was truly included in the build. The overall analysis is reasonable and useful but could have been more precise and complete.

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
